description: Worker gains a POST to GitHub (labels an issue directly).

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+package githubro
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// AddLabel labels an issue so triage is visible without an approval round trip.
+func (c *Client) AddLabel(ctx context.Context, repo string, number int, label string) error {
+	body := strings.NewReader(fmt.Sprintf(`{"labels":[%q]}`, label))
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost,
+		fmt.Sprintf("%s/repos/%s/issues/%d/labels", c.baseURL, repo, number), body)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("githubro: %w", err)
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.token)
+	_, err = c.http.Do(req)
+	return err
+}
